_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended through G.S.R. 779(E), G.S.R. 496(E), and subsequent notifications up to 2026)
_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, Government of India

rules.title: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer, Packer or Importer
rules.requirement: The name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where manufacturer is not packer, both manufacturer and packer; for imported packages, the name and complete address of the importer.
rules.applies_when: All pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale.
rules.does_not_apply_when: Packages containing net quantity <= 10g or <= 10ml exempt under Rule 26(a).
rules.official_source: Gazette of India G.S.R. 202(E) dt 07.03.2011 & G.S.R. 592(E) dt 23.06.2017
rules.evidence_required: Identified entity name and geographic address (city, state, PIN code/country).

rules.title: Country of Origin for Imported Products
rules.requirement: The name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly in case of imported products shall be mentioned on the package.
rules.applies_when: Pre-packaged commodities that are imported into India or assembled from imported parts.
rules.does_not_apply_when: Purely domestic products manufactured & packed in India by a domestic entity declared under Rule 6(1)(a).
rules.evidence_required: Country of origin declaration string (e.g., 'Country of Origin: India', 'Made in Vietnam').

rules.title: Common or Generic Commodity Name
rules.requirement: The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package; in case of packages containing more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product.
rules.evidence_required: Generic/common commodity name string on the packaging.

rules.title: Net Quantity in Standard SI Metric Units
rules.requirement: The net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight or measure (g, kg, ml, l, L, m, cm, mm, sq m, N, U). Non-standard units (gms, grm, kilos, ltrs, pcs) are prohibited.
rules.applies_when: All pre-packaged commodities sold by weight, measure, or count.
rules.does_not_apply_when: Packages containing net quantity <= 10g or <= 10ml exempt under Rule 26(a) (except tobacco products).
rules.official_source: Gazette of India G.S.R. 779(E) & Third Schedule
rules.evidence_required: Numerical value + valid SI metric unit symbol.

rules.title: Month and Year of Manufacture, Packing or Import
rules.requirement: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be mentioned (MM/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, or Month YYYY).
rules.does_not_apply_when: Packages with surface area <= 100 sq cm under Rule 26(b) conditions.
rules.evidence_required: Valid month/year or day/month/year date format.

rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Inclusive of All Taxes
rules.requirement: The retail sale price declared as 'Maximum Retail Price' or 'MRP ₹ / Rs. xx.xx' followed by mandatory 'inclusive of all taxes' or 'incl. of all taxes'.
rules.applies_when: All pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale.
rules.does_not_apply_when: Wholesale or institutional/industrial consumers under Rule 3 (Chapter II); Rule 26 small packages.
rules.evidence_required: Currency prefix (₹ / Rs.), numerical decimal amount, and 'inclusive of all taxes' clause.

rules.title: Unit Sale Price (USP)
rules.requirement: The unit sale price in ₹/Rs. per g (for < 1kg) or per kg (for > 1kg); per ml (for < 1L) or per L (for > 1L); per number/unit/meter.
rules.applies_when: Retail packages containing net quantity > 100g, > 100ml, or > 1m (where net quantity is not equal to 1kg, 1L, 1m, 1N).
rules.does_not_apply_when: Packages where net quantity is exactly 1kg, 1L, 1m, 1N or net quantity <= 100g or <= 100ml.
rules.evidence_required: Unit sale price string with required base unit denominator.

rules.title: Batch, Lot or Code Number
rules.requirement: A batch number or lot number or code number for manufacturing and supply chain traceability.
rules.does_not_apply_when: Fast food items packed by restaurants/hotels; unbranded bulk farm produce.

rules.title: Best Before or Use By Expiry Date
rules.requirement: The 'best before' or 'use by' date, month and year on commodities that may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time.
rules.applies_when: Perishable commodities (packaged foods, beverages, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics).
rules.does_not_apply_when: Non-perishable durable goods (hardware, metal tools, stationery, electronics).
rules.evidence_required: Expiry date string and chronological comparison (Expiry >= Manufacture Date).

rules.title: Consumer Care Cell Contact Details
rules.requirement: The name, address, telephone number, and email address of the person or consumer care cell for consumer complaints.
rules.applies_when: All pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale.
rules.evidence_required: Consumer care designation + valid telephone digits and/or email address.

rules.title: Small Package Exemption (<= 10g or <= 10ml)
rules.requirement: Packages containing net quantity <= 10g or <= 10ml are exempt from declaration of net quantity, retail price, and manufacturing date (except tobacco products).
rules.applies_when: Packages with confirmed net quantity <= 10g or <= 10ml.
rules.does_not_apply_when: Cigarettes, beedis, and other tobacco products (statutory exception).
rules.evidence_required: Confirmed net quantity <= 10g/ml and non-tobacco product classification.
